coverage.owner_conditions: Golden Duplex exemption: owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied. The shared kitchen/bath exemption applies only if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started. ADU-property exemption: tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 where either unit is owner-occupied.
coverage.other_conditions: Single-family homes are fully covered only if the current tenancy began before 1996. Government-subsidized units (Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME and others) are fully or partially covered depending on unit type. The 2026 AGA does not apply to tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 2025 with Costa-Hawkins rents.

result.notes: I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the rule covers ordinary multifamily rental buildings built before 1980. Its subsidy, tenancy and owner-occupancy carve-outs stay in unverifiable_exemptions. I set supersedes_state_rule to null and removed the Civ. Code § 1947.12 sentence from the summary, because no document mentions the state rent cap or how it relates to Berkeley's AGA. The construction cutoff follows D009 (Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 means partially covered). D006 says 'issued after 1980' and D009 also says 'built before 1980', so units completed between July and December 1980 are ambiguous and should be checked against the ordinance text.
